paragraphs: Clearfield makes fiber optic products and says it can satisfy the deployment needs of the service provider, engineer and network designer. For buyers with domestic sourcing requirements, the company offers BABA compliant products under Build America, Buy America.

Its NOVA high density panel supports high-density data communications environments. A companion cassette delivers a modular approach, simplifying data center, central office, and edge work. The same platform is marketed for data centers with edge to core flexibility. Installation is supported by a mobile app offering step-by-step, 3D interactive guides. Training and certifications are offered to close the skills gaps and improve capabilities.

A company patents page provides notice under 35 U.S.C. for the products and patents it lists. Products named there include a sealed optical fiber terminal. Clearfield announced a distribution agreement that expands access to its fiber, power, and wireless network infrastructure across the U.S. and Canada.
